```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(mice)

rm(list = ls())

# Set path 
abcd_fld <- Sys.getenv("abcd_fld")

```

## Create a template df with all subjectkeys and all timepoints (so every individual has 3 rows when merging variables later on - even if data is missing)
```{r}

subjectkeys <- glue("{abcd_fld}/abcd-general/abcd_y_lt.csv") %>% read.csv() %>% 
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname) %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id) 

template <- subjectkeys %>%
  distinct(subjectkey) %>% 
  mutate(eventname = list(c("baseline_year_1_arm_1", 
                          "2_year_follow_up_y_arm_1",
                          "4_year_follow_up_y_arm_1"))) %>% 
  unnest(eventname) %>%
  mutate(eventname = factor(eventname, levels = c("baseline_year_1_arm_1", 
                                               "2_year_follow_up_y_arm_1",
                                               "4_year_follow_up_y_arm_1"), ordered = TRUE))

str(template)
```



#### Load all data ####

# ELA factor scores

# Note: we found a labelling inconsistency for factors 3 and 4 in the original EFA loadings matrix. We therefore labelled these factors according to the content of the raw ABCD items: Factor 3 uses "crpbi_parent" items which correspond to youth report of primary caregiver, and Factor 4 uses "crpbi_caregiver" items which correspond to youth report of secondary caregiver.

```{r}
# Imputed adversity data (as a list)

ELAdata_fs <- readRDS("Data/Multiple_imputation/ELAdata_factor_scores.rds") # contains factor scores, interview age, and sex

# rename adversity factors for easier interpretation

ELAdata <- lapply(ELAdata_fs, function(df) {
 
  df_new <- df %>% rename(cg_psych = Factor1,
                          ses_dis_nsafety = Factor2,
                          primary_cg_lack_supp = Factor3,
                          second_cg_lack_supp = Factor4,
                          yp_family_conflict = Factor5,
                          cg_sub_use_bio_sep = Factor6,
                          family_anger_arg = Factor7,
                          family_aggression = Factor8,
                          trauma_exposure = Factor9,
                          lack_supervision = Factor10
                          )
  
  return(df_new)
   
}) 


# scale adversity factor scores

ELAdata <- lapply(ELAdata, function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(
      c(ses_dis_nsafety, primary_cg_lack_supp, 
        second_cg_lack_supp, yp_family_conflict, cg_sub_use_bio_sep, 
        family_anger_arg, family_aggression, trauma_exposure, 
        lack_supervision, cg_psych), 
      ~ as.vector(scale(.))
    ))
  
  return(df)
})

```


# Site and family id

```{r}
ids <- glue("{abcd_fld}/abcd-general/abcd_y_lt.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%  # get site and family id
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, rel_family_id, site_id_l) %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id,
         family_id = rel_family_id,
         site_id = site_id_l) %>%
  select(-eventname) %>%
  mutate(family_id = factor(family_id)) %>%
  mutate(site_id = factor(site_id))
```


# race-ethnicity

```{r}
# race ethnicity data

race_ethnicity <- glue("{abcd_fld}/abcd-general/abcd_p_demo.csv")  %>% read.csv() %>% 
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, race_ethnicity) %>% 
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>%
  mutate(
    new_col = factor(race_ethnicity, 
                       levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
                       labels = c("White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian", "Other"))) %>%
      select(-race_ethnicity, -eventname) %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id,
         race_ethnicity = new_col)
```



# BAS Reward Responsiveness

```{r}
# BIS/BAS scale data

bisbas <- glue("{abcd_fld}/mental-health/mh_y_bisbas.csv") %>% read.csv()	%>%
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, bis_y_ss_bas_rr, bis_y_ss_bas_fs, bis_y_ss_bas_drive, bis_y_ss_bis_sum, bis_y_ss_bism_sum, bis_y_ss_basm_rr, bis_y_ss_basm_drive) %>%
  
  rename( rew_resp = bis_y_ss_bas_rr, 
          fun_seeking = bis_y_ss_bas_fs,
          drive = bis_y_ss_bas_drive,
          bis = bis_y_ss_bis_sum,
          bis_modified = bis_y_ss_bism_sum,
          rew_resp_modified = bis_y_ss_basm_rr,
          drive_modified = bis_y_ss_basm_drive,
          subjectkey = src_subject_id
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(eventname = factor(eventname, levels = c("baseline_year_1_arm_1",  
                                               "2_year_follow_up_y_arm_1",
                                               "4_year_follow_up_y_arm_1"), ordered = TRUE))

bisbas <- left_join(template, bisbas, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname"))

rew_resp <- bisbas %>% select(subjectkey, eventname, rew_resp_modified)
```


# Resilience factors

```{r}
# resilience factor data (positive school environment and prosocial behaviour at baseline)

ps_behav <- glue("{abcd_fld}/culture-environment/ce_y_psb.csv") %>% read.csv() %>% 
  # youth report of prosocial behavior
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, psb_y_ss_mean) %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id,
         ps_behav = psb_y_ss_mean) %>%
  select(-eventname)
  
pos_school_env <- glue("{abcd_fld}/culture-environment/ce_y_srpf.csv") %>% read.csv() %>% 
  # youth report of positive school environment
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, srpf_y_ss_ses) %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id,
         pos_school_env = srpf_y_ss_ses) %>%
  select(-eventname)

# merge and scale for regressions
res_factors <- merge(ps_behav, pos_school_env, by = "subjectkey") %>% mutate(across(c(ps_behav, pos_school_env), ~ as.vector(scale(.))))
```

fmri <- readRDS("Data/Clean_data/fmri_qc.rds")

fmri <- left_join(template, fmri, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname")) %>%

## For puberty supplementary analysis: load and tidy pubertal development data, and split into sex stratified samples

```{r clean pubertal development data}

# pubertal development (parent reported and youth reported)

pds_parent <- glue("{abcd_fld}/physical-health/ph_p_pds.csv") %>% read.csv() %>% 
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, pubertal_sex_p,
                pds_p_ss_male_category_2, pds_p_ss_female_category_2) %>%
  filter(eventname %in% c("baseline_year_1_arm_1", "2_year_follow_up_y_arm_1", "4_year_follow_up_y_arm_1")) %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id,
         male_pds_parent = pds_p_ss_male_category_2,
         female_pds_parent = pds_p_ss_female_category_2,
         sex = pubertal_sex_p)


pds_youth <- glue("{abcd_fld}/physical-health/ph_y_pds.csv") %>% read.csv() %>% 
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, 
                pds_y_ss_female_category_2, pds_y_ss_male_cat_2) %>%
  filter(eventname %in% c("baseline_year_1_arm_1", "2_year_follow_up_y_arm_1", "4_year_follow_up_y_arm_1")) %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id,
         male_pds_youth = pds_y_ss_male_cat_2,
         female_pds_youth = pds_y_ss_female_category_2,
         )


pds <- merge(pds_parent, pds_youth, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname")) %>%
  mutate(eventname = factor(eventname, levels = c("baseline_year_1_arm_1",  # change eventname to factor 
                                               "2_year_follow_up_y_arm_1",
                                               "4_year_follow_up_y_arm_1"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(male_pds_parent, male_pds_youth, female_pds_parent, female_pds_youth), ~ as.vector(scale(.))))

pds <- left_join(template, pds, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname"))


# split into male and female groups for BIS/BAS models

male_subjectkeys <- pds %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1", sex == 1) %>%
  select(subjectkey)

male_group <- pds %>% filter(subjectkey %in% male_subjectkeys$subjectkey) %>%
  select(-sex, -female_pds_youth, -female_pds_parent) %>%
  rename(pds_youth = male_pds_youth,
         pds_parent = male_pds_parent)

female_subjectkeys <- pds %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1", sex == 2) %>%
  select(subjectkey)

female_group <- pds %>% filter(subjectkey %in% female_subjectkeys$subjectkey) %>%
  select(-sex, -male_pds_youth, -male_pds_parent) %>%
  rename(pds_youth = female_pds_youth,
         pds_parent = female_pds_parent)

# check available data (slightly more available for parent report)

male_group_available_dat <- sapply(male_group, function(x) sum(!is.na(x)))
male_group_available_dat

female_group_available_dat <- sapply(female_group, function(x) sum(!is.na(x)))
female_group_available_dat
```



For main models: prepare datasets for bisbas and MID BOLD responses linear mixed effects models


# Define functions

```{r}

# function to combine covariate and BAS data with each imputed dataset

combine_data <- function(df1, df2) {
  
 combined_data <- df1 %>%
    left_join(df2, by = "subjectkey")  

  return(combined_data)  
  
}

# function to recode male and female

convert_variables <- function(df) {
  
  df$subjectkey <- as.factor(df$subjectkey)
  df$sex <- factor(df$sex, 
                    levels = c(1, 2), 
                    labels = c("Male", "Female"))
  
  return(df)
  
}


# function to convert age/timepoint to continuous

convert_age <- function(df) {
  df$age <- dplyr::recode(df$eventname,
                           "baseline_year_1_arm_1" = 0,
                           "2_year_follow_up_y_arm_1" = 2,
                           "4_year_follow_up_y_arm_1" = 4)
  df$age_sq <- df$age^2
  
  df$age_log <- log(df$age + 1)
  return(df)
}
```


Create datasets for main behavioral and neural models

```{r}

# merge outcomes and non-adversity covariates

modvars_fmri <- fmri %>%
  left_join(ids, by = "subjectkey") %>%
  left_join(race_ethnicity, by = "subjectkey") %>%
  left_join(res_factors, by = "subjectkey")

modvars_bas <- rew_resp %>%
  left_join(ids, by = "subjectkey") %>%
  left_join(race_ethnicity, by = "subjectkey") %>%
  left_join(res_factors, by = "subjectkey")

# recode sex 
ELAdata <- lapply(ELAdata, convert_variables)

# merge datasets
fmri_for_model <- lapply(ELAdata, function(df2) combine_data(modvars_fmri, df2))
bas_for_model <- lapply(ELAdata, function(df2) combine_data(modvars_bas, df2))

# convert age
bas_for_model_age_cont <- lapply(bas_for_model, convert_age)
fmri_for_model_age_cont <- lapply(fmri_for_model, convert_age)


saveRDS(bas_for_model_age_cont, file = "Data/Clean_data/bas.rds")  
saveRDS(fmri_for_model_age_cont, file = "Data/Clean_data/fmri.rds")
```


For puberty supplementary models: prepare sex-stratified datasets

```{r join datasets and convert covariates to factors}
  
male <- left_join(male_group, modvars_bas, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname")) %>% 
  mutate(subjectkey = factor(subjectkey))

female <- left_join(female_group, modvars_bas, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname")) %>% 
  mutate(subjectkey = factor(subjectkey))

# Combine data and convert age to continuous

male <- lapply(ELAdata, function(df2) combine_data(male, df2))
male_age_cont <- lapply(male, convert_age)

female <- lapply(ELAdata, function(df2) combine_data(female, df2))
female_age_cont <- lapply(female, convert_age)



# save data for models
saveRDS(male_age_cont, file = "Data/Clean_data/data_for_model_bas_male.rds")
saveRDS(female_age_cont, file = "Data/Clean_data/data_for_model_bas_female.rds")

```
